info.title: Ciniyaana API (Karnataka Chalanachitra Academy)
info.description: Public GET endpoints serve the portal. Admin endpoints need a session: log in via POST /user/login (httpOnly cookies accessToken/refreshToken; access token ~15 min, refresh ~8 h). A Bearer access token is also accepted as a fallback. One active session per account: a newer login invalidates the older one (401 code SESSION_REPLACED). Uploads: JPG/PNG/WebP/GIF only, 10 MB each; double extensions and non-image content are rejected.
